svg.title: If all real derivatives vanish, using iψ also kills imaginary parts. Smooth compact test separation and continuity give pointwise vanishing on distinct configurations. Rigidity forces b = 0, so these real functionals separate B4. Choose finitely many spanning their dual span; their combined map is injective and has a linear left inverse. Use it and coordinates on B4 as Λ. Then PT3’s derivative is that coordinate isomorphism, proving PT4 with all profiles away from collisions.
